name: zclass_cls_di_pick_test_bbox_2d
description: zClass_cls_di::PickTestBBox2D checks active pick points against a node's view bbox in X/Z, clears miss flags, preserves inactive flags, and reports whether any active point remains inside.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass display-instance picking/source-cluster pass.
